title: Go: Structs
description: Define struct types, create instances, access fields, embed structs, and use struct tags.

steps.title: Define a Struct
steps.description: Define a struct `Person` with fields `Name string` and `Age int`. Create an instance and print it.
hints: `type Person struct { Name string; Age int }`
Create: `p := Person{"Alice", 30}` or with field names.

verification.failureMessage: Define Person struct with Name and Age, create instance, print it.

steps.title: Create Instances
steps.description: Define a `Book` struct with `Title string` and `Pages int`. Create instances using different styles (literal, named fields, var).

verification.failureMessage: Create two Book instances using different styles and print them.

steps.title: Access Fields
steps.description: Define a `Rectangle` struct with `Width` and `Height float64`. Create an instance and print its area by accessing fields.

verification.failureMessage: Create Rectangle{10,5}, compute area 50, and print.

steps.title: Embedded Fields
steps.description: Define an `Address` struct (City, Zip) and embed it in a `User` struct. Create a User and print its embedded fields.
hints: Embed by just using the type name: `Address`

verification.failureMessage: Embed Address in User, create instance, print City and Zip.

steps.title: Struct Tags
steps.description: Define a struct `Config` with field `Host string` tagged as `json:"host"` and `Port int` tagged as `json:"port"`. Use `reflect` to print the tag values.

verification.failureMessage: Define struct with json tags and print the tag values.
